  var CUSTOMIZE_STORAGE_KEY = 'whiskered-customize-cats';
  var customizeOpen = false;
  var activeTabId = null;
  var prevPanel = null;
  var prefs = {
    theme: 'dark',
    accent: 'orange',
    density: 'comfortable',
    welcome: true,
    reducedMotion: false
  };
  var accentPalettes = {
    lime:   { main: '#D7FF3F', strong: '#B9E62E', mid: '#C3E84A', pale: '#F2FFDD', light: '#E8FFA8' },
    orange: { main: '#FF9F45', strong: '#E07A1F', mid: '#FFAA6B', pale: '#FFF6EE', light: '#FFE0C0' },
    blue:   { main: '#3B82F6', strong: '#2563EB', mid: '#60A5FA', pale: '#EFF6FF', light: '#DBEAFE' },
    purple: { main: '#8B5CF6', strong: '#7C3AED', mid: '#A78BFA', pale: '#F5F3FF', light: '#EDE9FE' },
    green:  { main: '#16A34A', strong: '#15803D', mid: '#4ADE80', pale: '#F0FDF4', light: '#DCFCE7' },
    pink:   { main: '#FF6EC7', strong: '#E0399C', mid: '#FF94D6', pale: '#FFF0FA', light: '#FFD6EE' }
  };

  function loadPrefs() {
    try {
      var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CUSTOMIZE_STORAGE_KEY) || '{}');
      Object.assign(prefs, saved);
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!prefs.theme) prefs.theme = 'dark';
    if (!prefs.accent) prefs.accent = 'orange';
    if (!prefs.density) prefs.density = 'comfortable';
    if (typeof prefs.welcome !== 'boolean') prefs.welcome = true;
    if (typeof prefs.reducedMotion !== 'boolean') prefs.reducedMotion = false;
  }

  function savePrefs() {
    localStorage.setItem(CUSTOMIZE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(prefs));
    if (typeof Account !== 'undefined' && Account.syncPrefs) Account.syncPrefs();
  }

  function hexToRgba(hex, alpha) {
    var value = hex.replace('#', '');
    if (value.length === 3) {
      value = value.split('').map(function (ch) { return ch + ch; }).join('');
    }
    var intValue = parseInt(value, 16);
    var r = (intValue >> 16) & 255;
    var g = (intValue >> 8) & 255;
    var b = intValue & 255;
    return 'rgba(' + r + ', ' + g + ', ' + b + ', ' + alpha + ')';
  }

  function relLum(hex) {
    var v = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    return [v >> 16, (v >> 8) & 255, v & 255].map(function (c) {
      c /= 255;
      return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
    }).reduce(function (sum, c, i) { return sum + c * [0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722][i]; }, 0);
  }

  /* Darken a colour until it reaches at least 4.5:1 against the given background. */
  function readableOn(hex, bgHex) {
    var v = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    var r = v >> 16, g = (v >> 8) & 255, b = v & 255;
    var bgL = relLum(bgHex);
    for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      var cur = '#' + [r, g, b].map(function (c) { return ('0' + Math.round(c).toString(16)).slice(-2); }).join('');
      var l = relLum(cur);
      if ((bgL + 0.05) / (l + 0.05) >= 4.5) return cur;
      r *= 0.94; g *= 0.94; b *= 0.94;
    }
    return '#2C1400';
  }

  function applyPrefs() {
    var root = document.documentElement;
    var isDark = prefs.theme !== 'light';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
    document.body.classList.toggle('compact', prefs.density === 'compact');
    document.body.classList.toggle('hide-welcome-guidance', prefs.welcome === false);
    document.body.setAttribute('data-density', prefs.density || 'comfortable');
    document.body.setAttribute('data-motion', prefs.reducedMotion ? 'reduced' : 'normal');

    var palette = accentPalettes[prefs.accent] || accentPalettes.orange;
    var surface = isDark ? '#211A14' : '#FFFAF1';
    var acc = parseInt(palette.main.slice(1), 16);
    var lum = (0.299 * (acc >> 16) + 0.587 * ((acc >> 8) & 255) + 0.114 * (acc & 255)) / 255;

    root.style.setProperty('--accent', palette.main);
    root.style.setProperty('--accent-strong', palette.strong);
    root.style.setProperty('--accent-text', isDark ? palette.main : readableOn(palette.main, surface));
    root.style.setProperty('--on-accent', lum > 0.6 ? '#24160D' : '#FFFFFF');
    if (!isDark) root.style.setProperty('--soft', 'rgba(36, 22, 13, 0.07)');
    else root.style.setProperty('--soft', hexToRgba(palette.main, 0.14));

    updateCustomizeUI();
  }

  function updateCustomizeUI() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-choice]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.getAttribute('data-theme-choice') === prefs.theme);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-accent-choice]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.getAttribute('data-accent-choice') === prefs.accent);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-density-choice]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.getAttribute('data-density-choice') === prefs.density);
    });

    var welcomeBtn = document.querySelector('[data-toggle="welcome"]');
    if (welcomeBtn) {
      welcomeBtn.classList.toggle('active', prefs.welcome);
      welcomeBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(prefs.welcome));
    }

    var motionBtn = document.querySelector('[data-toggle="motion"]');
    if (motionBtn) {
      motionBtn.classList.toggle('active', prefs.reducedMotion);
      motionBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(prefs.reducedMotion));
    }

  }

  function openCustomizePanel() {
    var overlay = document.getElementById('customize-overlay');
    if (!overlay) return;
    customizeOpen = true;
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-customize');
    if (closeBtn) closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeCustomizePanel() {
    var overlay = document.getElementById('customize-overlay');
    if (!overlay) return;
    customizeOpen = false;
    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }

  /* ---- Transition helpers ---------------------------------- */
  function getActiveView() {
    var views = [
      document.getElementById('welcome-screen'),
      document.getElementById('itchio-view'),
      document.getElementById('itchio-genre-view'),
      document.getElementById('websites-view'),
      document.getElementById('support-view'),
      document.getElementById('admin-view'),
      document.getElementById('team-view')
    ];
    for (var i = 0; i < views.length; i++) {
      if (views[i] && views[i].style.display !== 'none') return views[i];
    }
    if (prevPanel && !prevPanel.hidden && prevPanel.classList.contains('active')) {
      return prevPanel;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function animateOut(el, then) {
    if (!el) { then(); return; }
    el.classList.add('page-exiting');
    setTimeout(function () {
      el.classList.remove('page-exiting');
      then();
    }, 180);
  }

  function animateIn(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.add('page-entering');
    el.addEventListener('animationend', function handler() {
      el.classList.remove('page-entering');
      el.removeEventListener('animationend', handler);
    });
  }

  /* ---- Mode switching -------------------------------------- */
  function setNavActive(mode) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.topbar-link').forEach(function (l) {
      var on = l.getAttribute('data-nav') === mode;
      l.classList.toggle('active', on);
      if (on) l.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page'); else l.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
  }

  function setMode(mode) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.topbar-link').forEach(function (l) {
      var n = l.getAttribute('data-nav');
      var on = n === mode || (n === 'itchio' && mode === 'itchio-genre');
      l.classList.toggle('active', on);
      if (on) l.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page'); else l.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    var itchioView = document.getElementById('itchio-view');
    var welcomeScreen = document.getElementById('welcome-screen');
    var websitesView = document.getElementById('websites-view');
    var supportView = document.getElementById('support-view');
    var inboxView = document.getElementById('admin-view');
    var teamView = document.getElementById('team-view');
    var currentView = getActiveView();

    animateOut(currentView, function () {
      var itchioGenreView = document.getElementById('itchio-genre-view');
      if (itchioView) itchioView.style.display = 'none';
      if (itchioGenreView) itchioGenreView.style.display = 'none';
      if (welcomeScreen) welcomeScreen.style.display = 'none';
      if (websitesView) websitesView.style.display = 'none';
      if (supportView) supportView.style.display = 'none';
      if (inboxView) inboxView.style.display = 'none';
      if (teamView) teamView.style.display = 'none';
      document.querySelectorAll('.content-panel').forEach(function (p) {
        p.hidden = true;
        p.classList.remove('active');
      });
      prevPanel = null;
      activeTabId = null;

      var target;
      if (mode === 'itchio') {
        if (itchioView) { itchioView.style.display = 'flex'; target = itchioView; }
      } else if (mode === 'websites') {
        if (websitesView) { websitesView.style.display = ''; target = websitesView; }
      } else if (mode === 'support') {
        if (supportView) { supportView.style.display = ''; target = supportView; Support.show(); }
      } else if (mode === 'team') {
        if (teamView) { teamView.style.display = ''; target = teamView; Team.show(); }
      } else if (mode === 'admin' && Account.isAdmin()) {
        if (inboxView) { inboxView.style.display = ''; target = inboxView; Support.showInbox(); }
      } else {
        if (welcomeScreen) { welcomeScreen.style.display = ''; target = welcomeScreen; }
      }
      animateIn(target);
    });
  }

  /* ---- Show a site panel (no tab elements needed) ---------- */
  function showPanel(siteId) {
    var panel = document.getElementById('panel-' + siteId);
    if (!panel) return;
    setNavActive('websites');
    var currentView = getActiveView();

    animateOut(currentView, function () {
      var websitesView = document.getElementById('websites-view');
      if (websitesView) websitesView.style.display = 'none';
      var welcomeEl = document.getElementById('welcome-screen');
      if (welcomeEl) welcomeEl.style.display = 'none';
      var supportEl = document.getElementById('support-view');
      if (supportEl) supportEl.style.display = 'none';
      var inboxEl = document.getElementById('admin-view');
      if (inboxEl) inboxEl.style.display = 'none';
      var teamEl = document.getElementById('team-view');
      if (teamEl) teamEl.style.display = 'none';

      if (prevPanel && prevPanel !== panel) {
        prevPanel.classList.remove('active');
        prevPanel.hidden = true;
      }

      activeTabId = siteId;
      panel.hidden = false;
      panel.scrollTop = 0;
      panel.classList.remove('exiting');
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          panel.classList.add('active');
          animateIn(panel);
          panel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        });
      });
      prevPanel = panel;
      history.replaceState(null, '', '#panel-' + siteId);
    });
  }

  /* ---- Build Itch.io genre grid ---------------------------- */
  function buildItchioView() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('itchio-genre-grid');
    if (!grid) return;

    GENRES.forEach(function (genre) {
      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'sites-card';
      var iconHtml = genre.svg
        ? '<svg class="sites-card-icon-svg" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" focusable="false">' + genre.svg + '</svg>'
        : genre.iconImg
          ? '<img class="sites-card-icon-img' + (genre.iconBlend ? ' sites-card-icon-img-blend' : '') + '" src="' + genre.iconImg + '" alt="" />'
          : genre.icon;
      btn.innerHTML =
        '<span class="sites-card-icon" aria-hidden="true">' + iconHtml + '</span>' +
        '<span class="sites-card-name">' + genre.label + '</span>';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () { showGenre(genre); });
      grid.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  /* ---- Show individual genre page -------------------------- */
  function showGenre(genre) {
    Links.setGenre(genre);
    setNavActive('itchio');
    var currentView = getActiveView();
    var genreView = document.getElementById('itchio-genre-view');
    var genreTitle = document.getElementById('itchio-genre-title');
    var container = document.querySelector('.itchio-placeholder-buttons');

    animateOut(currentView, function () {
      var itchioView = document.getElementById('itchio-view');
      if (itchioView) itchioView.style.display = 'none';

      if (genreTitle) genreTitle.textContent = genre.label;
      var genreCount = document.getElementById('itchio-genre-count');
      var gameList = GENRE_GAMES[genre.id] || [];
      if (genreCount) genreCount.textContent = gameList.length + (gameList.length === 1 ? ' game' : ' games');

      if (container) {
        container.innerHTML = '';
        var games = GENRE_GAMES[genre.id] || [];
        if (!games.length) {
          var empty = document.createElement('p');
          empty.className = 'itchio-empty';
          empty.textContent = 'No games here yet. The cat knocked them off the shelf!';
          container.appendChild(empty);
        }
        games.forEach(function (game, i) {
          var a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = game.url;
          a.target = '_blank';
          a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
          a.className = 'itchio-placeholder-btn';
          a.style.animationDelay = Math.min(i * 30, 300) + 'ms';
          a.dataset.name = game.label.toLowerCase();
          var cover = document.createElement('span');
          cover.className = 'game-cover';
          if (game.img) {
            var img = document.createElement('img');
            img.src = game.img;
            img.alt = '';
            img.loading = 'lazy';
            cover.appendChild(img);
          } else {
            var letter = document.createElement('span');
            letter.className = 'game-cover-letter';
            letter.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            letter.textContent = game.label.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
            cover.appendChild(letter);
          }
          var name = document.createElement('span');
          name.className = 'game-name';
          name.textContent = game.label;
          a.appendChild(cover);
          a.appendChild(name);
          if (Links.admin()) {
            a.dataset.key = Links.norm(game.url);
            a.appendChild(Links.removeBtn('game', genre.id, game.url, game.editId));
            a.appendChild(Links.moveBtns(a, '.itchio-placeholder-btn', 'game:' + genre.id, 'x'));
          }
          container.appendChild(a);
        });

        if (Links.admin()) Links.sortable(container, '.itchio-placeholder-btn', 'game:' + genre.id, 'x');
        var search = document.getElementById('game-search');
        if (search) {
          search.value = '';
          search.hidden = games.length < 7;
          search.oninput = function () {
            var q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
            var shown = 0;
            container.querySelectorAll('.itchio-placeholder-btn').forEach(function (card) {
              var match = !q || card.dataset.name.indexOf(q) !== -1;
              card.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
              if (match) shown++;
            });
            var none = container.querySelector('.itchio-nomatch');
            if (!shown && !none) {
              none = document.createElement('p');
              none.className = 'itchio-empty itchio-nomatch';
              none.textContent = 'Nothing found. Try another sniff?';
              container.appendChild(none);
            } else if (shown && none) {
              none.remove();
            }
          };
        }
      }

      if (genreView) {
        var oldBar = genreView.querySelector('.admin-bar');
        if (oldBar) oldBar.remove();
        var gs = document.getElementById('game-search');
        if (Links.admin() && gs) gs.parentNode.insertBefore(Links.form('game', genre.id), gs);
      }
      if (genreView) genreView.style.display = '';
      animateIn(genreView);
    });
  }

  /* ---- Build websites view --------------------------------- */
  function escHtml(t) { return String(t).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"'); }

  function updateSiteCounts() {
    var cs = document.getElementById('count-sites');
    var ncs = document.getElementById('nav-count-sites');
    if (cs) cs.textContent = SITES.length + ' sites';
    if (ncs) ncs.textContent = SITES.length;
  }

  function buildWebsitesView() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('websites-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.textContent = '';

    SITES.forEach(function (site) {
      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'sites-card';
      btn.innerHTML =
        '<span class="sites-card-icon" aria-hidden="true">' + escHtml(site.icon) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="sites-card-name">' + escHtml(site.label) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="sites-card-tagline">' + escHtml(site.tagline) + '</span>';
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () { showPanel(site.id); });
      grid.appendChild(btn);
    });

    var old = document.querySelector('#websites-view .admin-wrap');
    if (old) old.remove();
    if (Links.admin()) grid.parentNode.insertBefore(Links.siteForm(), grid);
  }

  /* previous / next buttons on a site panel */
  function fillPager(pager, siteIdx) {
    pager.textContent = '';
    [['prev', siteIdx - 1, 'Previous'], ['next', siteIdx + 1, 'Next']].forEach(function (cfg) {
      var target = SITES[cfg[1]];
      var b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'pager-btn ' + cfg[0];
      b.innerHTML = '<span></span><strong></strong>';
      b.firstChild.textContent = cfg[2];
      if (target) {
        b.lastChild.textContent = (cfg[0] === 'prev' ? '← ' : '') + target.label + (cfg[0] === 'next' ? ' →' : '');
        b.addEventListener('click', function () { showPanel(target.id); });
      } else { b.disabled = true; b.lastChild.textContent = '-'; }
      pager.appendChild(b);
    });
  }

  /* refresh the numbers on a panel after sites or links change */
  function updatePanelMeta(panel) {
    var idx = SITES.findIndex(function (x) { return x.id === panel.id.replace('panel-', ''); });
    if (idx < 0) return;
    var n = panel.querySelectorAll('.link-card').length;
    var k = panel.querySelector('.ph-kicker');
    if (k) k.textContent = 'Site ' + (idx < 9 ? '0' : '') + (idx + 1) + ' / ' + SITES.length + ' · ' + (n ? n + (n === 1 ? ' link' : ' links') : 'No links yet');
    var facts = panel.querySelectorAll('.about-fact strong');
    if (facts[0]) facts[0].textContent = n || '—';
    if (facts[1]) facts[1].textContent = (idx + 1) + ' of ' + SITES.length;
    var pager = panel.querySelector('.pager');
    if (pager) fillPager(pager, idx);
  }

  /* ---- Dialogs ----------------------------------------------- *
   * In-page replacements for confirm() and alert(). Browsers silently
   * block those inside sandboxed frames, so buttons that asked "are you
   * sure?" quietly did nothing there.
   */
  var Dialog = (function () {
    var overlay, text, ok, cancel, done = null, last = null, queue = Promise.resolve();
    function el(tag, cls, t) { var n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (t != null) n.textContent = t; return n; }
    function build() {
      overlay = el('div', 'customize-overlay dialog-overlay'); overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      var panel = el('div', 'customize-panel dialog-panel');
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'alertdialog'); panel.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true'); panel.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'dialog-text');
      text = el('p', 'dialog-text'); text.id = 'dialog-text';
      var actions = el('div', 'dialog-actions');
      cancel = el('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Cancel'); cancel.type = 'button';
      ok = el('button', 'acct-submit', 'OK'); ok.type = 'button';
      actions.appendChild(cancel); actions.appendChild(ok);
      panel.appendChild(text); panel.appendChild(actions); overlay.appendChild(panel);
      document.body.appendChild(overlay);
      ok.addEventListener('click', function () { finish(true); });
      cancel.addEventListener('click', function () { finish(false); });
      overlay.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === overlay) finish(false); });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (!done || e.key !== 'Escape') return;
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); finish(false);
      }, true);
    }
    function finish(v) {
      if (!done) return;
      var d = done; done = null;
      overlay.classList.remove('open'); overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      if (last && last.focus) { try { last.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
      d(v);
    }
    function show(message, opts) {
      var p = queue.then(function () {
        return new Promise(function (resolve) {
          if (!overlay) build();
          last = document.activeElement;
          text.textContent = message;
          ok.textContent = opts.ok; cancel.hidden = !opts.cancel;
          done = resolve;
          overlay.classList.add('open'); overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
          setTimeout(function () { ok.focus(); }, 30);
        });
      });
      queue = p.then(function () {}, function () {});
      return p;
    }
    return {
      confirm: function (message, label) { return show(message, { cancel: true, ok: label || 'Confirm' }); },
      alert: function (message) { return show(message, { cancel: false, ok: 'OK' }); }
    };
  })();

    var accounts = {}, cur = null, curKey = null, sess = null, tab = 'login', busy = false, el = {}, pushTimer = null, listeners = [];
    var announce = false, toastEl = null, toastTimer = null;
    function toast(msg) {
      if (!toastEl) { toastEl = document.createElement('div'); toastEl.className = 'toast'; toastEl.setAttribute('role', 'status'); document.body.appendChild(toastEl); }
      toastEl.textContent = msg;
      toastEl.classList.add('show');

      toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { toastEl.classList.remove('show'); }, 3200);

    function load(k) { try { return localStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }

    function setTab(t) {

        })
        .catch(function (e) { verifyMsg(e.message || 'Could not check that code.'); })
        .then(function () { el.verifyConfirm.disabled = false; });
    }

    /* forgot password: ask for a code, then set a new password */
    var resetStep = 1;
    function resetMsg(t, bad) { el.resetMsg.textContent = t || ''; el.resetMsg.hidden = !t; el.resetMsg.classList.toggle('ok', !bad); }
    function showReset(on) {
      el.resetForm.hidden = !on;
      el.form.hidden = on;
      el.forgot.hidden = on || !REMOTE;
      document.querySelectorAll('#acct-guest .option-row').forEach(function (r) { r.hidden = on; });
      if (on) {
        resetStep = 1; el.resetStep2.hidden = true; el.resetSubmit.textContent = 'Send code'; resetMsg('');
        el.resetUser.value = el.user.value.trim() || el.resetUser.value;
        el.resetUser.readOnly = false;
        setTimeout(function () { el.resetUser.focus(); }, 30);
      } else {
        el.resetCode.value = ''; el.resetPass.value = ''; el.resetPass2.value = '';
      }
    }
    function submitReset(ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      if (busy) return;
      var name = el.resetUser.value.trim();
      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,20}$/.test(name)) return resetMsg('Enter your username.', true);
      busy = true; el.resetSubmit.disabled = true; resetMsg('');
      var req;
      if (resetStep === 1) {
        req = sb('/rest/v1/rpc/request_password_reset', { method: 'POST', body: { uname: name } }).then(function (r) {
          resetMsg(r.message, !r.ok);
          if (r.ok) {
            resetStep = 2; el.resetStep2.hidden = false; el.resetUser.readOnly = true;
            el.resetSubmit.textContent = 'Reset password'; el.resetCode.focus();
          }
        });
      } else {
        var code = el.resetCode.value.trim(), pw = el.resetPass.value;
        if (!code) req = Promise.reject(new Error('Type the code from the email.'));
        else if (pw.length < 6) req = Promise.reject(new Error('The password must be at least 6 characters.'));
        else if (pw !== el.resetPass2.value) req = Promise.reject(new Error('The passwords do not match.'));
        else req = sb('/rest/v1/rpc/complete_password_reset', { method: 'POST', body: { uname: name, code: code, new_password: pw } }).then(function (r) {
          if (!r.ok) return resetMsg(r.message, true);
          var u = name;
          showReset(false);
          el.user.value = u; el.pass.value = '';
          setTab('login');
          toast('Password changed. Log in with your new password.');
          el.pass.focus();
        });
      }
      req.catch(function (e) { resetMsg((e && e.message) || 'Something went wrong.', true); })
        .then(function () { busy = false; el.resetSubmit.disabled = false; });
    }

    function paint() {
      var a = cur;
      el.guest.hidden = !!a; el.userView.hidden = !a;
      el.label.textContent = a ? a.display : 'Log in';
      el.initial.textContent = a ? a.display.charAt(0) : '';
      el.initial.hidden = !a;
      var sideBtn = document.getElementById('side-account');
      if (sideBtn) sideBtn.classList.toggle('logged-in', !!a);
      el.sub.textContent = a ? 'Signed in as @' + a.username + (role.owner ? ' \u00b7 owner' : role.admin ? ' \u00b7 admin' : '') : 'Log in or make an account';
      el.title.textContent = a ? 'Hi, ' + a.display + '!' : 'Account';
      if (a) {
        el.avatar.textContent = a.display.charAt(0);
        el.dispName.textContent = a.display;
        el.userName.textContent = '@' + a.username;
        el.displayIn.value = a.display;
        el.emailIn.value = a.email || '';
        paintVerify();
        el.sync.setAttribute('aria-pressed', a.sync ? 'true' : 'false');
        el.sync.classList.toggle('active', !!a.sync);
      }
    }
    function applySaved() {
      if (cur && cur.sync && cur.prefs && Object.keys(cur.prefs).length) {
        Object.assign(prefs, cur.prefs);
        try { localStorage.setItem(CUSTOMIZE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(prefs)); } catch (e) {}
        if (el.ready) applyPrefs();
      }
    }
    var lastError = '';
    function reportError(msg) {
      lastError = String(msg || '').slice(0, 140);
      if (el.diag && lastError) el.diag.textContent = el.diag.textContent.split(' \u00b7 Error:')[0] + ' \u00b7 Error: ' + lastError;
    }
    window.addEventListener('error', function (e) { reportError(e.message); });
    window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function (e) { reportError(e.reason && e.reason.message ? e.reason.message : e.reason); });
    function checkServer() {
      if (!el.diag) return;
      el.diag.textContent = 'Page version ' + APP_VERSION + ' \u00b7 Server: checking...' + (lastError ? ' \u00b7 Error: ' + lastError : '');
      var t0 = Date.now();
      sb('/auth/v1/settings').then(function () {
        el.diag.textContent = 'Page version ' + APP_VERSION + ' \u00b7 Server: reachable (' + (Date.now() - t0) + ' ms)' + (lastError ? ' \u00b7 Error: ' + lastError : '');
      }).catch(function (e) {
        el.diag.textContent = 'Page version ' + APP_VERSION + ' \u00b7 Server: ' + (e.message || 'not reachable');
      });
    }
    function open() {
      checkServer();
      paint();
      el.overlay.classList.add('open'); el.overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      setTimeout(function () { (cur ? el.displayIn : el.user).focus(); }, 50);
    }
    function close() {
      el.overlay.classList.remove('open'); el.overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      showError(''); el.pass.value = ''; el.pass2.value = ''; el.email.value = '';
      if (!el.resetForm.hidden) showReset(false);
    }
    function done() {
      busy = false; announce = false; el.submit.disabled = false;
      el.submit.textContent = tab === 'signup' ? 'Create account' : 'Log in';
    }
    function fail(e) { showError((e && e.message) || String(e || 'Something went wrong.')); }

    function enter(profile, key) {
      cur = profile; curKey = key || null;
      if (REMOTE && (!cur.prefs || !Object.keys(cur.prefs).length)) { cur.prefs = clone(prefs); pushProfile({ prefs: cur.prefs }); }
      role = { admin: false, owner: false };
      applySaved(); paint(); notify();
      if (announce) { announce = false; toast('Logged in as @' + cur.username); }
      loadRole();
    }

    /* what this account may do is decided by the database, not by the page */
    function loadRole() {
      if (!REMOTE || !sess) return;
      token().then(function (t) {
        return Promise.all([
          sb('/rest/v1/rpc/is_admin', { method: 'POST', body: {} }, t),
          sb('/rest/v1/rpc/is_owner', { method: 'POST', body: {} }, t).catch(function () { return false; })
        ]);
      }).then(function (r) {
        role = { admin: r[0] === true, owner: r[1] === true };
        paint(); notify();
      }).catch(function () {});
    }

    /* ---- submit ---- */
    function submit(ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      if (busy) return;
      var name = el.user.value.trim(), pw = el.pass.value, email = el.email.value.trim();
      var nameOk = /^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,20}$/.test(name);
      if (!nameOk) return showError('Username must be 3-20 letters, numbers or underscores.');
      if (tab === 'signup') {
        if (email && !validEmail(email)) return showError('That email address doesn\'t look right. Leave it empty if you prefer.');
        if (pw.length < 6) return showError('Password must be at least 6 characters.');
        if (pw !== el.pass2.value) return showError('Passwords do not match.');
      } else if (!pw) return showError('Enter your password.');
      busy = true; announce = true; el.submit.disabled = true; showError('');
      el.submit.textContent = tab === 'signup' ? 'Creating account...' : 'Logging in...';
      Promise.resolve().then(function () { return REMOTE ? remoteSubmit(name, pw, email) : localSubmit(name, pw, email); }).catch(fail).then(done);
    }

    function remoteSubmit(name, pw, contact) {
      var email = aliasEmail(name);
      if (tab === 'signup') {
        return sb('/rest/v1/rpc/username_available', { method: 'POST', body: { name: name } }).then(function (ok) {
          if (ok === false) throw new Error('That username is taken.');
          return sb('/auth/v1/signup', { method: 'POST', body: { email: email, password: pw, data: { username: name } } });
        }).then(function (j) {
          if (!j || !j.access_token) throw new Error('Sign-up needs email confirmation turned off in Supabase (Authentication > Sign In / Providers > Email).');
          setSession(j);
          return fetchProfile().then(function (p) {
            if (contact && emailOk) { p.email = contact; pushProfile({ email: contact }); }
            enter(p); close();
          });
        });
      }
      return sb('/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password', { method: 'POST', body: { email: email, password: pw } }).catch(function (e) {
        if (/invalid login/i.test(e.message)) throw new Error('Wrong username or password.');
        if (/banned/i.test(e.message)) throw new Error('This account has been banned.');
        throw e;
      }).then(function (j) {
        setSession(j);
        return fetchProfile().then(function (p) { enter(p); close(); });
      });
    }

    function localSubmit(name, pw, contact) {
      var key = name.toLowerCase();
      if (tab === 'signup') {
        if (accounts[key]) return Promise.reject(new Error('That username is taken.'));
        var salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
        return hash(pw, salt).then(function (h) {
          accounts[key] = { username: name, display: name, salt: b64(salt), hash: h, created: Date.now(), sync: true, prefs: clone(prefs), email: contact || '' };
          if (!persist()) { delete accounts[key]; throw new Error('Could not save. Is browser storage blocked?'); }
          save(SESSION_KEY, key); enter(accounts[key], key); close();
        });
      }
      var a = accounts[key];
      return hash(pw, a ? unb64(a.salt) : new Uint8Array(16)).then(function (h) {
        if (!a || !same(h, a.hash)) throw new Error('Wrong username or password.');
        save(SESSION_KEY, key); enter(a, key); close();
      });
    }

    function logout() {
      if (REMOTE && sess) { var t = sess.access_token; sb('/auth/v1/logout', { method: 'POST' }, t).catch(function () {}); }
      cur = null; curKey = null; sess = null; drop(SESSION_KEY); drop(SB_KEY);
      role = { admin: false, owner: false };
      paint(); close(); notify(); toast('Logged out');
    }

    function saveName() {
      var v = el.displayIn.value.trim().slice(0, 24);
      if (!cur || !v) return;
      cur.display = v;
      if (REMOTE) pushProfile({ display: v }); else persist();
      paint();
    }
    function saveEmail() {
      if (!cur) return;
      var v = el.emailIn.value.trim();
      function msg(t) { el.emailMsg.textContent = t; }
      if (v && !validEmail(v)) return msg('That email address doesn\'t look right.');
      if (REMOTE) {
        if (!emailOk) return msg('Saving an email isn\'t set up yet.');
        token().then(function (t) { return sb('/rest/v1/profiles?id=eq.' + sess.uid, { method: 'PATCH', body: { email: v || null }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }, t); })
          .then(function () {
            if (cur.email !== (v || null)) cur.email_verified = false;
            cur.email = v || null;
            msg(v ? 'Saved. Verify it below to use it for password resets.' : 'Email removed.');
            paintVerify();
          })
          .catch(function (e) { msg(e.message || 'Could not save.'); });
      } else {
        cur.email = v; persist(); msg(v ? 'Saved.' : 'Email removed.');
      }
    }
    function toggleSync() {
      if (!cur) return;
      cur.sync = !cur.sync;
      if (cur.sync) cur.prefs = clone(prefs);
      if (REMOTE) pushProfile({ sync: cur.sync, prefs: cur.prefs || {} }); else persist();
      paint();
    }
    function deleteAccount() {
      if (!cur) return;
      Dialog.confirm('Delete the account @' + cur.username + '? This cannot be undone.', 'Delete account').then(function (yes) {
        if (!yes) return;
        if (REMOTE) {
          token().then(function (t) { return sb('/rest/v1/rpc/delete_own_account', { method: 'POST', body: {} }, t); })
            .then(logout).catch(function (e) { Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Could not delete the account.'); });
        } else { delete accounts[curKey]; persist(); logout(); }
      });
    }

    return {
      init: function () {
        var $ = function (i) { return document.getElementById(i); };
        el = { overlay: $('account-overlay'), guest: $('acct-guest'), userView: $('acct-user-view'), form: $('acct-form'), user: $('acct-user'),
          pass: $('acct-pass'), pass2: $('acct-pass2'), confirmWrap: $('acct-confirm-wrap'),
          error: $('acct-error'), submit: $('acct-submit'), label: $('acct-label'), initial: $('acct-initial'), sub: $('account-sub'), title: $('account-title'), avatar: $('acct-avatar'),
          dispName: $('acct-display-name'), userName: $('acct-username'), displayIn: $('acct-display'), sync: $('acct-sync'), note: $('acct-note'), diag: $('acct-diag'),
          emailWrap: $('acct-email-wrap'), email: $('acct-email'), emailIn: $('acct-email-in'), emailMsg: $('acct-email-msg'),
          verify: $('acct-verify'), verifyStatus: $('acct-verify-status'), verifySend: $('acct-verify-send'), verifyRow: $('acct-verify-row'), verifyCode: $('acct-verify-code'), verifyConfirm: $('acct-verify-confirm'),
          forgot: $('acct-forgot'), resetForm: $('acct-reset-form'), resetUser: $('acct-reset-user'), resetStep2: $('acct-reset-step2'), resetCode: $('acct-reset-code'),
          resetPass: $('acct-reset-pass'), resetPass2: $('acct-reset-pass2'), resetMsg: $('acct-reset-msg'), resetSubmit: $('acct-reset-submit') };
        if (!el.overlay) return;
        el.note.textContent = REMOTE ? 'Your account is stored securely online, so it works on any device.' : 'Accounts are stored in this browser only. They don\'t sync between devices.';
        el.ready = false;
        if (REMOTE) {
          try { sess = JSON.parse(load(SB_KEY) || 'null'); } catch (e) { sess = null; }
        } else {
          try { accounts = JSON.parse(load(ACC_KEY) || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) { accounts = {}; }
          var k = load(SESSION_KEY);
          if (k && accounts[k]) { cur = accounts[k]; curKey = k; applySaved(); }
        }
        paint();
        el.ready = true;

        $('side-account').addEventListener('click', open);
        $('close-account').addEventListener('click', close);
        el.overlay.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === el.overlay) close(); });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape' && el.overlay.classList.contains('open')) close(); });
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-acct-tab]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { setTab(b.getAttribute('data-acct-tab')); }); });
        el.form.addEventListener('submit', submit);
        $('acct-logout').addEventListener('click', logout);
        $('acct-save-name').addEventListener('click', saveName);
        $('acct-save-email').addEventListener('click', saveEmail);
        el.verifySend.addEventListener('click', sendVerification);
        el.verifyConfirm.addEventListener('click', confirmVerification);
        el.forgot.hidden = !REMOTE;
        el.forgot.addEventListener('click', function () { showReset(true); });
        $('acct-reset-back').addEventListener('click', function () { showReset(false); });
        el.resetForm.addEventListener('submit', submitReset);
        el.sync.addEventListener('click', toggleSync);
        $('acct-delete').addEventListener('click', deleteAccount);
        setTab('login');

        if (REMOTE && sess) {
          fetchProfile().then(function (p) { enter(p); }).catch(function (e) {
            if (/fetch|reach|server|connection/i.test(e.message)) return;
            sess = null; drop(SB_KEY);
          });
        }
      },
      remote: REMOTE,
      username: function () { return cur ? cur.username : ''; },
      loggedIn: function () { return !!cur; },
      open: open,
      isAdmin: function () { return REMOTE && !!cur && role.admin; },
      isOwner: function () { return REMOTE && !!cur && role.owner; },
      onChange: function (f) { listeners.push(f); },
      api: function (path, opts, authed) {
        return authed ? token().then(function (t) { return sb(path, opts, t); }) : sb(path, opts);
      },
      syncPrefs: function () {
