        cur.prefs = clone(prefs);
        if (REMOTE) { clearTimeout(pushTimer); pushTimer = setTimeout(function () { pushProfile({ prefs: cur.prefs }); }, 600); }
        else persist();
      }
    };
  })();

  /* ---- Link editing (admin) --------------------------------- *
   * Links in index.html are the defaults. The `link_edits` table in
   * Supabase layers changes on top: 'add' rows appear, 'remove' rows
   * hide a default link. Everyone reads it; only the admin account can
   * write (enforced by row-level security, see supabase-admin.sql).
   */
  var Links = (function () {
    var edits = [], origGames = null, origSites = {}, genre = null;
    var X = '<svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg>';

    function norm(u) { try { return new URL(u, location.href).href; } catch (e) { return u; } }
    function make(tag, cls, text) { var n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; }
    function mine(kind, target, op) { return edits.filter(function (e) { return e.kind === kind && e.target === target && e.op === op; }); }
    function removedSet(kind, target) { var r = {}; mine(kind, target, 'remove').forEach(function (e) { r[norm(e.url)] = 1; }); return r; }

    function apply() {
      if (!origGames) origGames = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(GENRE_GAMES));
      var keys = {};
      Object.keys(origGames).forEach(function (k) { keys[k] = 1; });
      edits.forEach(function (e) { if (e.kind === 'game') keys[e.target] = 1; });
      Object.keys(keys).forEach(function (g) {
        var gone = removedSet('game', g);
        var list = (origGames[g] || []).filter(function (x) { return !gone[norm(x.url)]; });
        mine('game', g, 'add').forEach(function (e) { list.push({ label: e.label || e.url, url: e.url, img: e.img || undefined, editId: e.id }); });
        GENRE_GAMES[g] = ordered(list, orders['game:' + g], function (x) { return norm(x.url); });
      });
    }

    function rebuildSite(id) {
      var panel = document.getElementById('panel-' + id);
      var sec = panel && panel.querySelector('.links-section');
      if (!sec || origSites[id] == null) return;
      sec.innerHTML = origSites[id];
      var gone = removedSet('site', id);
      sec.querySelectorAll('a.site-link').forEach(function (a) {
        if (gone[norm(a.getAttribute('href'))]) (a.closest('.link-row') || a).remove();
      });
      mine('site', id, 'add').forEach(function (e) {
        var a = make('a', 'site-link', e.url);
        a.href = e.url; a.target = '_blank'; a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'; a.dataset.editId = e.id;
        sec.appendChild(a);
      });
      var ord = orders['site:' + id];
      if (ord) {
        var nodes = Array.prototype.map.call(sec.querySelectorAll('a.site-link'), function (a) { return { n: a.closest('.link-row') || a, k: norm(a.getAttribute('href')) }; });
        ordered(nodes, ord, function (o) { return o.k; }).forEach(function (o) { sec.appendChild(o.n); });
      }
      buildLinksBoard(sec, id);
      updatePanelMeta(panel);
    }

    function rebuildAll() {
      Object.keys(origSites).forEach(rebuildSite);
      var gv = document.getElementById('itchio-genre-view');
      if (genre && gv && gv.style.display !== 'none') showGenre(genre);
    }

    function refresh() {
      return Account.api('/rest/v1/link_edits?select=*&order=id.asc').then(function (rows) {
        edits = rows || []; apply(); rebuildAll();
      });
    }

    function write(req) {
      return req.then(refresh).catch(function (e) { Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Could not save that change.'); });
    }

    /* ---- ordering ---- */
    var ORD_KEY = 'whiskered-order-cache', orders = {}, orderOpen = false;
    var CHEV = {
      up: '<path d="m6 15 6-6 6 6"/>', down: '<path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/>',
      left: '<path d="m15 6-6 6 6 6"/>', right: '<path d="m9 6 6 6-6 6"/>'
    };
    function icon(name) { return '<svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">' + CHEV[name] + '</svg>'; }
    function keyOf(el) { return el.dataset.key || el.dataset.url || ''; }
    function ordered(arr, keys, kf) {
      if (!keys || !keys.length) return arr;
      var rank = {}; keys.forEach(function (k, i) { rank[k] = i; });
      return arr.map(function (x, i) { var k = kf(x); return { x: x, i: i, r: k in rank ? rank[k] : 1e6 }; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return a.r - b.r || a.i - b.i; })
        .map(function (o) { return o.x; });
    }
    function applySiteOrder() {
      var before = SITES.map(function (x) { return x.id; }).join();
      var sorted = ordered(SITES.slice(), orders['sites'], function (x) { return x.id; });
      Array.prototype.splice.apply(SITES, [0, SITES.length].concat(sorted));
      return before !== SITES.map(function (x) { return x.id; }).join();
    }
    function keysIn(container, sel) {
      return Array.prototype.filter.call(container.children, function (n) { return n.matches(sel); }).map(keyOf);
    }
    function saveOrder(scope, keys) {
      return Account.api('/rest/v1/order_edits?on_conflict=scope',
        { method: 'POST', body: { scope: scope, items: keys, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }, headers: { Prefer: 'resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal' } }, true)
        .then(refreshOrders).catch(function (e) { Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Could not save the new order.'); });
    }
    function applyOrders(rows) {
      orders = {};
      (rows || []).forEach(function (r) { orders[r.scope] = r.items; });
      try { localStorage.setItem(ORD_KEY, JSON.stringify(rows || [])); } catch (e) {}
      applySiteOrder();
      apply();
      rebuildAll();
      buildWebsitesView();
      document.querySelectorAll('.content-panel').forEach(updatePanelMeta);
    }
    function refreshOrders() {
      return Account.api('/rest/v1/order_edits?select=*').then(applyOrders);
    }
    function visibleSibling(el, dir, sel) {
      var n = dir < 0 ? el.previousElementSibling : el.nextElementSibling;
      while (n && (!n.matches(sel) || n.hidden || n.style.display === 'none')) n = dir < 0 ? n.previousElementSibling : n.nextElementSibling;
      return n;
    }
    function shift(el, sel, scope, dir) {
      var t = visibleSibling(el, dir, sel);
      if (!t) return;
      el.parentNode.insertBefore(el, dir < 0 ? t : t.nextElementSibling);
      saveOrder(scope, keysIn(el.parentNode, sel));
    }
    function moveBtns(el, sel, scope, axis) {
      var w = make('span', 'admin-move');
      [['Move earlier', axis === 'x' ? 'left' : 'up', -1], ['Move later', axis === 'x' ? 'right' : 'down', 1]].forEach(function (c) {
        var b = make('button', 'admin-mv'); b.type = 'button'; b.title = c[0]; b.setAttribute('aria-label', c[0]); b.innerHTML = icon(c[1]);
        b.addEventListener('click', function (ev) { ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); shift(el, sel, scope, c[2]); });
        w.appendChild(b);
      });
      return w;
    }
    function sortable(container, sel, scope, axis) {
      var drag = null;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(container.children, function (el) {
        if (!el.matches(sel)) return;
        el.draggable = true; el.classList.add('sortable');
        el.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) {
          drag = el; el.classList.add('dragging');
          if (e.dataTransfer) { e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move'; try { e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', keyOf(el)); } catch (x) {} }
        });
        el.addEventListener('dragover', function (e) {
          if (!drag || drag === el) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
          var after = axis === 'x' ? e.clientX > r.left + r.width / 2 : e.clientY > r.top + r.height / 2;
          container.insertBefore(drag, after ? el.nextElementSibling : el);
        });
        el.addEventListener('drop', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
        el.addEventListener('dragend', function () {
          if (!drag) return;
          drag.classList.remove('dragging'); drag = null;
          saveOrder(scope, keysIn(container, sel));
        });
      });
    }

    /* ---- site edits (name, tagline, description) ---- */
    var OV_KEY = 'whiskered-site-overrides', overrides = {};
    function paintSite(site) {
      var panel = document.getElementById('panel-' + site.id);
      var d = panel && panel.querySelector('.panel-description');
      if (!site.base) site.base = { label: site.label, tagline: site.tagline, icon: site.icon, description: d ? d.textContent : (site.description || '') };
      var o = overrides[site.id], b = site.base;
      site.label = o ? o.label : b.label;
      site.tagline = o ? o.tagline : b.tagline;
      site.icon = o ? (o.label.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || b.icon) : b.icon;
      if (!panel) return;
      var h2 = panel.querySelector('.panel-header h2'); if (h2) h2.textContent = site.label;
      var tg = panel.querySelector('.ph-tagline'); if (tg) tg.textContent = site.tagline;
      var ic = panel.querySelector('.ph-icon'); if (ic) ic.textContent = site.icon;
      if (d) d.textContent = o ? o.description : b.description;
    }
    function applyOverrides(rows) {
      overrides = {};
      (rows || []).forEach(function (r) { overrides[r.slug] = r; });
      try { localStorage.setItem(OV_KEY, JSON.stringify(rows || [])); } catch (e) {}
      SITES.forEach(paintSite);
      buildWebsitesView();
      document.querySelectorAll('.content-panel').forEach(updatePanelMeta);
    }
    function refreshOverrides() {
      return Account.api('/rest/v1/site_overrides?select=*').then(applyOverrides);
    }
    function editForm(site, onClose) {
      var box = make('form', 'admin-bar admin-edit');
      box.autocomplete = 'off';
      var name = make('input', 'admin-input'); name.maxLength = 40; name.required = true; name.value = site.label; name.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Site name');
      var tag = make('input', 'admin-input'); tag.maxLength = 120; tag.value = site.tagline; tag.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Tagline');
      var desc = make('textarea', 'admin-input'); desc.maxLength = 600; desc.rows = 4; desc.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Description');
      var panel = document.getElementById('panel-' + site.id), d = panel && panel.querySelector('.panel-description');
      desc.value = d ? d.textContent : (site.description || '');
      var save = make('button', 'admin-add', 'Save changes'); save.type = 'submit';
      var cancel = make('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Cancel'); cancel.type = 'button';
      var msg = make('span', 'admin-msg'); msg.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
      [name, tag, desc, save, cancel].forEach(function (n) { box.appendChild(n); });
      if (overrides[site.id] && !site.custom) {
        var reset = make('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Reset to original'); reset.type = 'button';
        reset.addEventListener('click', function () {
          Dialog.confirm('Put the original text back?', 'Reset').then(function (yes) {
            if (!yes) return;
            Account.api('/rest/v1/site_overrides?slug=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(site.id), { method: 'DELETE' }, true)
              .then(refreshOverrides).then(onClose).catch(function (e) { msg.textContent = e.message || 'Could not reset.'; });
          });
        });
        box.appendChild(reset);
      }
      box.appendChild(msg);
      cancel.addEventListener('click', onClose);
      box.addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        var label = name.value.trim();
        if (!label) { msg.textContent = 'The site needs a name.'; return; }
        save.disabled = true; msg.textContent = '';
        Account.api('/rest/v1/site_overrides?on_conflict=slug',
          { method: 'POST', body: { slug: site.id, label: label, tagline: tag.value.trim(), description: desc.value.trim(), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() },
            headers: { Prefer: 'resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal' } }, true)
          .then(refreshOverrides).then(onClose)
          .catch(function (e) { save.disabled = false; msg.textContent = e.message || 'Could not save.'; });
      });
      return box;
    }

    /* ---- custom sites ---- */
    var CACHE_KEY = 'whiskered-custom-sites';
    function siteOf(id) { return SITES.find(function (x) { return x.id === id; }); }
    function toSite(r) { return { id: r.slug, label: r.label, icon: (r.label || '?').charAt(0).toUpperCase(), tagline: r.tagline || '', description: r.description || '', custom: true, dbId: r.id }; }
    function makePanel(site) {
      var sec = make('section', 'content-panel');
      sec.id = 'panel-' + site.id; sec.setAttribute('role', 'tabpanel'); sec.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'tab-' + site.id); sec.tabIndex = -1; sec.hidden = true;
      var inner = make('div', 'panel-inner');
      var head = make('div', 'panel-header'); head.appendChild(make('h2', null, site.label));
      inner.appendChild(head);
      inner.appendChild(make('p', 'panel-description', site.description || 'A site added by the cats.'));
      inner.appendChild(make('div', 'links-section'));
      sec.appendChild(inner);
      var all = document.querySelectorAll('.content-panel');
      var last = all[all.length - 1];
      last.parentNode.insertBefore(sec, last.nextSibling);
      return sec;
    }
    function syncSites(rows) {
      rows = rows || [];
      var want = {}, changed = false;
      rows.forEach(function (r) { want[r.slug] = r; });
      SITES.filter(function (x) { return x.custom && !want[x.id]; }).forEach(function (x) {
        var pn = document.getElementById('panel-' + x.id);
        if (pn) pn.remove();
        SITES.splice(SITES.indexOf(x), 1);
        delete origSites[x.id];
        changed = true;
      });
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        if (siteOf(r.slug)) return;
        var st = toSite(r);
        SITES.push(st);
        enhancePanels([makePanel(st)]);
        paintSite(st);
        changed = true;
      });
      try { localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(rows)); } catch (e) {}
      if (changed) {
        buildWebsitesView(); updateSiteCounts();
        document.querySelectorAll('.content-panel').forEach(updatePanelMeta);
      }
    }
    function refreshSites() {
      return Account.api('/rest/v1/custom_sites?select=*&order=id.asc').then(syncSites);
    }
    function slugFor(name) {
      var base = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 36) || 'site';
      if (base.length < 2) base += '-x';
      var slug = base, n = 2;
      while (siteOf(slug)) slug = base + '-' + (n++);
      return slug;
    }

    Account.onChange(function () { rebuildAll(); buildWebsitesView(); });

    return {
      admin: function () { return Account.isAdmin(); },
      remember: function (id, sec) { origSites[id] = sec.innerHTML; },
      setGenre: function (g) { genre = g; },
      load: function () {
        if (!Account.remote) return;
        refresh().catch(function () {});
        refreshSites().catch(function () {});
        refreshOverrides().catch(function () {});
        refreshOrders().catch(function () {});
      },
      applyCachedOrder: function () {
        if (!Account.remote) return;
        var rows = [];
        try { rows = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ORD_KEY) || '[]') || []; } catch (e) {}
        rows.forEach(function (r) { orders[r.scope] = r.items; });
        applySiteOrder();
      },
      norm: norm,
      moveBtns: moveBtns,
      sortable: sortable,
      applyCachedOverrides: function () {
        if (!Account.remote) return;
        var rows = [];
        try { rows = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(OV_KEY) || '[]') || []; } catch (e) {}
        if (rows.length) applyOverrides(rows);
      },
      applyCachedSites: function () {
        if (!Account.remote) return;
        var rows = [];
        try { rows = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY) || '[]') || []; } catch (e) {}
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          if (!r || !r.slug || siteOf(r.slug)) return;
          var st = toSite(r);
          SITES.push(st);
          makePanel(st);
        });
      },
      siteForm: function () {
        var f = make('form', 'admin-bar');
        f.autocomplete = 'off';
        f.appendChild(make('span', 'admin-tag', 'Admin'));
        var name = make('input', 'admin-input'); name.placeholder = 'Site name'; name.maxLength = 40; name.required = true; name.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Site name');
        var tag = make('input', 'admin-input'); tag.placeholder = 'Tagline'; tag.maxLength = 120; tag.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Tagline');
        var desc = make('input', 'admin-input'); desc.placeholder = 'Short description'; desc.maxLength = 600; desc.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Description');
        var btn = make('button', 'admin-add', 'Add site'); btn.type = 'submit';
        var ro = make('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Reorder sites'); ro.type = 'button';
        var msg = make('span', 'admin-msg'); msg.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
        [name, tag, desc, btn, ro, msg].forEach(function (n) { f.appendChild(n); });
        var wrap = make('div', 'admin-wrap');
        wrap.appendChild(f);
        function orderBox() {
          var box = make('div', 'admin-bar admin-orderbox');
          box.appendChild(make('p', 'admin-note', 'Drag a site, or use the arrows. Changes save as you go.'));
          var ol = make('ol', 'admin-order');
          SITES.forEach(function (st) {
            var li = make('li', 'admin-order-item'); li.dataset.key = st.id;
            li.appendChild(make('span', 'admin-order-name', st.label));
            li.appendChild(moveBtns(li, 'li.admin-order-item', 'sites', 'y'));
            ol.appendChild(li);
          });
          sortable(ol, 'li.admin-order-item', 'sites', 'y');
          box.appendChild(ol);
          return box;
        }
        if (orderOpen) wrap.appendChild(orderBox());
        ro.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var ex = wrap.querySelector('.admin-orderbox');
          if (ex) { ex.remove(); orderOpen = false; } else { wrap.appendChild(orderBox()); orderOpen = true; }
        });
        f.addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          var label = name.value.trim();
          if (label.length < 1) { msg.textContent = 'Give the site a name.'; return; }
          btn.disabled = true; msg.textContent = '';
          var slug = slugFor(label);
          Account.api('/rest/v1/custom_sites', { method: 'POST', body: { slug: slug, label: label, tagline: tag.value.trim(), description: desc.value.trim() }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }, true)
            .then(refreshSites)
            .then(function () { showPanel(slug); })
            .catch(function (e) { btn.disabled = false; msg.textContent = e.message || 'Could not add that site.'; });
        });
        return wrap;
      },
      form: function (kind, target) {
        var f = make('form', 'admin-bar');
        f.autocomplete = 'off';
        var title = make('span', 'admin-tag', 'Admin');
        var name = null, img = null;
        f.appendChild(title);
        if (kind === 'game') {
          name = make('input', 'admin-input'); name.placeholder = 'Game name'; name.maxLength = 80; name.required = true; name.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Game name');
          f.appendChild(name);
        }
        var url = make('input', 'admin-input'); url.type = 'url'; url.placeholder = 'https://...'; url.required = true; url.maxLength = 2000; url.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Link URL');
        f.appendChild(url);
        if (kind === 'game') {
          img = make('input', 'admin-input'); img.type = 'url'; img.placeholder = 'Cover image URL (optional)'; img.maxLength = 2000; img.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Cover image URL');
          f.appendChild(img);
        }
        var btn = make('button', 'admin-add', 'Add link'); btn.type = 'submit';
        var msg = make('span', 'admin-msg'); msg.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
        f.appendChild(btn);
        var cs = kind === 'site' && siteOf(target);
        if (cs) {
          var ed = make('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Edit site'); ed.type = 'button';
          function closeEdit() { var x = f.nextElementSibling; if (x && x.classList.contains('admin-edit')) x.remove(); }
          ed.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var x = f.nextElementSibling;
            if (x && x.classList.contains('admin-edit')) { x.remove(); return; }
            f.after(editForm(cs, closeEdit));
          });
          f.appendChild(ed);
        }
        if (cs && cs.custom) {
          var del = make('button', 'admin-danger', 'Delete site'); del.type = 'button';
          del.addEventListener('click', function () {
            Dialog.confirm('Delete the site "' + cs.label + '" and all its links for everyone?', 'Delete site').then(function (yes) {
              if (!yes) return;
              Account.api('/rest/v1/link_edits?kind=eq.site&target=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(target), { method: 'DELETE' }, true)
                .then(function () { return Account.api('/rest/v1/site_overrides?slug=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(target), { method: 'DELETE' }, true).catch(function () {}); })
                .then(function () { return Account.api('/rest/v1/custom_sites?id=eq.' + cs.dbId, { method: 'DELETE' }, true); })
                .then(function () { return Promise.all([refresh(), refreshSites()]); })
                .then(function () { setMode('websites'); })
                .catch(function (e) { msg.textContent = e.message || 'Could not delete that site.'; });
            });
          });
          f.appendChild(del);
        }
        f.appendChild(msg);
        f.addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          msg.textContent = '';
          var u = url.value.trim(), im = img ? img.value.trim() : '';
          if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(u) || (im && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(im))) { msg.textContent = 'Links must start with http:// or https://'; return; }
          var row = { kind: kind, target: target, op: 'add', url: u };
          if (name) row.label = name.value.trim();
          if (im) row.img = im;
          btn.disabled = true;
          Account.api('/rest/v1/link_edits', { method: 'POST', body: row, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }, true)
            .then(refresh)
            .catch(function (e) { btn.disabled = false; msg.textContent = /duplicate|unique/i.test(e.message) ? 'That link is already added.' : (e.message || 'Could not add that link.'); });
        });
        return f;
      },
      removeBtn: function (kind, target, url, editId) {
        var b = make('button', 'admin-del'); b.type = 'button'; b.title = 'Remove this link'; b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove this link');
        b.innerHTML = X;
        b.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
          ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();
          Dialog.confirm('Remove this link for everyone?', 'Remove').then(function (yes) {
            if (!yes) return;
            write(editId
              ? Account.api('/rest/v1/link_edits?id=eq.' + editId, { method: 'DELETE' }, true)
              : Account.api('/rest/v1/link_edits', { method: 'POST', body: { kind: kind, target: target, op: 'remove', url: norm(url) }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }, true));
          });
        });
        return b;
      }
    };
  })();

  /* ---- Changelog (admin editable) --------------------------- *
   * CHANGELOG above is the default. Once the admin clicks "Start editing",
   * the entries move into the `changelog_entries` table in Supabase and
   * that becomes the source of truth for everyone.
   */
  var Changelog = (function () {
    var KEY = 'whiskered-changelog-cache', rows = null, list = null, busy = false;
    var ICON = {
      up: '<path d="m6 15 6-6 6 6"/>', down: '<path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/>',
      edit: '<path d="M4 20h4L19 9l-4-4L4 16z"/><path d="m13.5 6.5 4 4"/>', x: '<path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/>'
    };
    function make(tag, cls, text) { var n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; }
    function svg(name) { return '<svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">' + ICON[name] + '</svg>'; }
    function iconBtn(cls, name, label, fn) {
      var b = make('button', cls); b.type = 'button'; b.title = label; b.setAttribute('aria-label', label); b.innerHTML = svg(name);
      b.addEventListener('click', fn);
      return b;
    }
    function managed() { return !!(rows && rows.length); }
    function items() {
      return managed() ? rows.map(function (r) { return { row: r, badge: r.badge, text: r.body }; })
                       : CHANGELOG.map(function (e) { return { badge: e.badge, text: e.text }; });
    }

    function whatsNew(first) {
      var box = document.getElementById('whats-new-body');
      if (!box) return;
      box.textContent = '';
      if (!first) { box.appendChild(make('p', null, 'Nothing new yet.')); return; }
      box.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', first.badge));
      box.appendChild(make('p', null, first.text));
    }

    function call(req) {
      if (busy) return;
      busy = true;
      req.then(reload).catch(function (e) { Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Could not save that change.'); }).then(function () { busy = false; });
    }
    function api(path, opts) { return Account.api('/rest/v1/changelog_entries' + path, opts, true); }
    function reload() {
      return Account.api('/rest/v1/changelog_entries?select=*&order=position.asc,id.asc').then(function (r) {
        rows = r || [];
        try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(rows)); } catch (e) {}
        render();
      });
    }

    function addForm() {
      var f = make('form', 'admin-bar');
      f.autocomplete = 'off';
      f.appendChild(make('span', 'admin-tag', 'Admin'));
      var badge = make('input', 'admin-input'); badge.placeholder = 'Label (e.g. New game)'; badge.maxLength = 30; badge.required = true; badge.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Label');
      var body = make('textarea', 'admin-input'); body.placeholder = 'What changed?'; body.maxLength = 500; body.rows = 3; body.required = true; body.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Entry text');
      var add = make('button', 'admin-add', 'Add entry'); add.type = 'submit';
      [badge, body, add].forEach(function (n) { f.appendChild(n); });
      f.addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        var b = badge.value.trim(), t = body.value.trim();
        if (!b || !t) return;
        var top = rows.reduce(function (m, r) { return Math.min(m, r.position); }, 0);
        call(api('', { method: 'POST', body: { position: top - 1, badge: b, body: t }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }));
      });
      return f;
    }

    function editForm(r) {
      var f = make('form', 'admin-bar admin-edit');
      f.autocomplete = 'off';
      var badge = make('input', 'admin-input'); badge.maxLength = 30; badge.required = true; badge.value = r.badge; badge.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Label');
      var body = make('textarea', 'admin-input'); body.maxLength = 500; body.rows = 3; body.required = true; body.value = r.body; body.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Entry text');
      var save = make('button', 'admin-add', 'Save'); save.type = 'submit';
      var cancel = make('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Cancel'); cancel.type = 'button';
      [badge, body, save, cancel].forEach(function (n) { f.appendChild(n); });
      cancel.addEventListener('click', render);
      f.addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        var b = badge.value.trim(), t = body.value.trim();
        if (!b || !t) return;
        call(api('?id=eq.' + r.id, { method: 'PATCH', body: { badge: b, body: t }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }));
      });
      return f;
    }

    function swap(a, b) {
      call(Promise.all([
        api('?id=eq.' + a.id, { method: 'PATCH', body: { position: b.position }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }),
        api('?id=eq.' + b.id, { method: 'PATCH', body: { position: a.position }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } })
      ]));
    }

    function render() {
      list = list || document.getElementById('changelog-list');
      if (!list) return;
      var admin = Account.isAdmin(), data = items();
      list.textContent = '';
      if (admin) {
        var top = make('li');
        if (managed()) top.appendChild(addForm());
        else {
          var start = make('div', 'admin-bar');
          start.appendChild(make('span', 'admin-tag', 'Admin'));
          start.appendChild(make('span', 'admin-note', 'Move the changelog online so you can add, edit and reorder entries.'));
          var go = make('button', 'admin-add', 'Start editing'); go.type = 'button';
          go.addEventListener('click', function () {
            call(api('', { method: 'POST', body: CHANGELOG.map(function (e, i) { return { position: i, badge: e.badge, body: e.text }; }), headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }));
          });
          start.appendChild(go);
          top.appendChild(start);
        }
        list.appendChild(top);
      }
      data.forEach(function (it, i) {
        var li = make('li', 'changelog-entry');
        var meta = make('div', 'changelog-meta');
        meta.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', it.badge));
        if (admin && it.row) {
          var tools = make('span', 'cl-tools');
          if (i > 0) tools.appendChild(iconBtn('admin-mv', 'up', 'Move up', function () { swap(it.row, data[i - 1].row); }));
          if (i < data.length - 1) tools.appendChild(iconBtn('admin-mv', 'down', 'Move down', function () { swap(it.row, data[i + 1].row); }));
          tools.appendChild(iconBtn('admin-mv', 'edit', 'Edit entry', function () { li.textContent = ''; li.appendChild(editForm(it.row)); }));
          tools.appendChild(iconBtn('admin-del', 'x', 'Delete entry', function () {
            Dialog.confirm('Delete this changelog entry for everyone?', 'Delete').then(function (yes) { if (yes) call(api('?id=eq.' + it.row.id, { method: 'DELETE' })); });
          }));
          meta.appendChild(tools);
        }
        li.appendChild(meta);
        li.appendChild(make('p', null, it.text));
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
      whatsNew(data[0]);
    }

    return {
      init: function () {
        if (Account.remote) {
          try { var c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); if (c && c.length) rows = c; } catch (e) {}
        }
        render();
        if (Account.remote) {
          Account.onChange(render);
          Account.api('/rest/v1/changelog_entries?select=*&order=position.asc,id.asc').then(function (r) {
            rows = r || [];
            try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(rows)); } catch (e) {}
            render();
          }).catch(function () {});
        }
      }
    };
  })();

  /* ---- Support page ----------------------------------------- *
   * Messages go to the `support_requests` table (see supabase-support.sql).
   * Anyone can send one; only the admin can read them.
   */
  var Support = (function () {
    var LAST_KEY = 'whiskered-support-last', COOLDOWN = 30000, el = {};
    var KINDS = { broken: 'Broken link', suggest: 'Suggestion', account: 'Account help', other: 'Other' };
    function make(tag, cls, text) { var n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; }
    function note(msg) { el.note.textContent = msg || ''; el.note.hidden = !msg; }

    function gate() {
      var on = Account.loggedIn();
      el.user.value = Account.username();
      el.form.hidden = !on;
      el.gate.hidden = on;
      if (on) note('');
    }

    function fmtTime(t) { return new Date(t).toLocaleString([], { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }); }
    function groupBy(reps) {
      var g = {};
      (reps || []).forEach(function (x) { (g[x.request_id] = g[x.request_id] || []).push(x); });
      return g;
    }
    function threadEl(list, seenBefore, me) {
      var ul = make('ul', 'support-thread');
      list.forEach(function (x) {
        var li = make('li', 'support-reply' + (me && x.id > seenBefore && x.author.toLowerCase() !== me ? ' fresh' : ''));
        var head = make('div', 'support-reply-head');
        head.appendChild(make('strong', null, '@' + x.author));
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', 'Team'));
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-when', fmtTime(x.created_at)));
        li.appendChild(head);
        li.appendChild(make('p', 'support-msg', x.body));
        ul.appendChild(li);
      });
      return ul;
    }
    function setBadge(n) { if (el.supportBadge) el.supportBadge.textContent = n || ''; }
    function seenKey() { return 'whiskered-support-seen-' + Account.username().toLowerCase(); }

    /* "My messages": the sender's own tickets and any replies */
    function refreshMine() {
      if (!el.mineCard) return;
      if (!Account.loggedIn()) { el.mineCard.hidden = true; setBadge(0); return; }
      var me = Account.username();
      Account.api('/rest/v1/support_requests?select=*&username=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(me) + '&order=id.desc&limit=30', {}, true).then(function (rows) {
        rows = rows || [];
        var ids = rows.map(function (r) { return r.id; }).join(',');
        var reps = ids ? Account.api('/rest/v1/support_replies?select=*&order=id.asc&request_id=in.(' + ids + ')', {}, true) : Promise.resolve([]);
        return reps.then(function (rp) { renderMine(rows, rp || []); });
      }).catch(function () { el.mineCard.hidden = true; });
    }
    function renderMine(rows, reps) {
      var me = Account.username().toLowerCase(), by = groupBy(reps), seen = 0;
      try { seen = +localStorage.getItem(seenKey()) || 0; } catch (e) {}
      var maxId = seen, unread = 0;
      reps.forEach(function (x) {
        if (x.id > maxId) maxId = x.id;
        if (x.id > seen && x.author.toLowerCase() !== me) unread++;
      });
      var sv = document.getElementById('support-view');
      var onPage = sv && sv.style.display !== 'none';
      el.mineCard.hidden = !rows.length;
      el.mineList.textContent = '';
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var li = make('li', 'support-item' + (r.status === 'done' ? ' done' : ''));
        var head = make('div', 'support-item-head');
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', KINDS[r.kind] || r.kind));
        if (r.status === 'done') head.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', 'Done'));
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-when', fmtTime(r.created_at)));
        li.appendChild(head);
        li.appendChild(make('p', 'support-msg', r.message));
        var th = by[r.id] || [];
        if (th.length) li.appendChild(threadEl(th, seen, me));
        else li.appendChild(make('p', 'support-waiting', 'No reply yet.'));
        el.mineList.appendChild(li);
      });
      if (onPage) { try { localStorage.setItem(seenKey(), String(maxId)); } catch (e) {} setBadge(0); }
      else setBadge(unread);
    }

    function loadInbox() {
      var admin = Account.isAdmin();
      if (el.navBtn) el.navBtn.hidden = !admin;
      if (!admin) {
        if (el.navCount) el.navCount.textContent = '';
        var iv = document.getElementById('admin-view');
        if (iv && iv.style.display !== 'none') setMode('support');
        loadAdmins();
        loadUsers();
        return;
      }
      loadAdmins();
      loadUsers();
      Promise.all([
        Account.api('/rest/v1/support_requests?select=*&order=id.desc&limit=100', {}, true),
        Account.api('/rest/v1/profiles?select=username,email&email=not.is.null', {}, true).catch(function () { return []; })
      ]).then(function (res) {
          var map = {};
          (res[1] || []).forEach(function (p) { map[p.username.toLowerCase()] = p.email; });
          var rows = res[0] || [];
          var ids = rows.map(function (r) { return r.id; }).join(',');
          var reps = ids ? Account.api('/rest/v1/support_replies?select=*&order=id.asc&request_id=in.(' + ids + ')', {}, true).catch(function () { return []; }) : Promise.resolve([]);
          return reps.then(function (rp) { renderInbox(rows, map, groupBy(rp)); });
        })
        .catch(function (e) { el.list.textContent = ''; el.list.appendChild(make('li', 'support-empty', e.message || 'Could not load messages.')); });
    }
    function loadUsers() {
      var card = document.getElementById('users-card');
      if (!card) return;
      card.hidden = !Account.isAdmin();
      if (!Account.isAdmin()) return;
      var q = document.getElementById('users-q').value.trim();
      var ul = document.getElementById('users-list'), bl = document.getElementById('bans-list');
      Account.api('/rest/v1/rpc/list_users', { method: 'POST', body: { q: q } }, true).then(function (rows) { renderUsers(ul, rows || []); })
        .catch(function (e) { ul.textContent = ''; ul.appendChild(make('li', 'support-empty', e.message || 'Could not load users.')); });
      Account.api('/rest/v1/rpc/list_bans', { method: 'POST', body: {} }, true).then(function (rows) { renderBans(bl, rows || []); })
        .catch(function () { bl.textContent = ''; });
    }
    function banAction(path, body) {
      return Account.api('/rest/v1/rpc/' + path, { method: 'POST', body: body }, true).then(function (r) {
        if (!r.ok) Dialog.alert(r.message);
        loadUsers();
      }).catch(function (e) { Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Something went wrong.'); });
    }
    function unbanButton(name) {
      var b = make('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Unban'); b.type = 'button';
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { banAction('unban_user', { target: name }); });
      return b;
    }
    function renderUsers(ul, rows) {
      ul.textContent = '';
      if (!rows.length) { ul.appendChild(make('li', 'support-empty', 'No accounts match.')); return; }
      var me = Account.username().toLowerCase();
      rows.forEach(function (u) {
        var li = make('li', 'support-item' + (u.banned ? ' done' : ''));
        var head = make('div', 'support-item-head');
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-who', '@' + u.name));
        if (u.display && u.display !== u.name) head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-when', u.display));
        if (u.is_owner) head.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', 'Owner'));
        else if (u.is_admin) head.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', 'Admin'));
        if (u.banned) head.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', 'Banned'));
        li.appendChild(head);
        if (u.banned && u.reason) li.appendChild(make('p', 'support-msg', 'Reason: ' + u.reason));
        if (!u.is_owner && u.name.toLowerCase() !== me) {
          var tools = make('div', 'support-tools');
          if (u.banned) tools.appendChild(unbanButton(u.name));
          else {
            var why = make('input', 'ban-reason'); why.type = 'text'; why.maxLength = 300; why.placeholder = 'Reason (optional)'; why.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Reason for banning @' + u.name);
            var ban = make('button', 'admin-ghost danger ban-btn', 'Ban'); ban.type = 'button';
            if (u.is_admin && !Account.isOwner()) { ban.disabled = true; ban.title = 'Only the owner can ban another admin'; }
            ban.addEventListener('click', function () {
              Dialog.confirm('Ban @' + u.name + '? They will be signed out everywhere and can\'t log in or send messages until you unban them.', 'Ban').then(function (yes) {
                if (yes) banAction('ban_user', { target: u.name, why: why.value.trim() });
              });
            });
            tools.appendChild(why); tools.appendChild(ban);
          }
          li.appendChild(tools);
        }
        ul.appendChild(li);
      });
    }
    function renderBans(ul, rows) {
      ul.textContent = '';
      if (!rows.length) { ul.appendChild(make('li', 'support-empty', 'Nobody is banned.')); return; }
      rows.forEach(function (b) {
        var li = make('li', 'support-item');
        var head = make('div', 'support-item-head');
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-who', '@' + b.name));
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-when', 'by @' + b.banned_by + ' · ' + fmtTime(b.banned_at)));
        li.appendChild(head);
        if (b.reason) li.appendChild(make('p', 'support-msg', 'Reason: ' + b.reason));
        var tools = make('div', 'support-tools'); tools.appendChild(unbanButton(b.name)); li.appendChild(tools);
        ul.appendChild(li);
      });
    }
    function bindUsers() {
      var f = document.getElementById('users-form');
      if (f) f.addEventListener('submit', function (ev) { ev.preventDefault(); loadUsers(); });
    }
    function loadAdmins() {
      var card = document.getElementById('admins-card');
      if (!card) return;
      card.hidden = !Account.isOwner();
      if (!Account.isOwner()) return;
      var list = document.getElementById('admins-list');
      Account.api('/rest/v1/rpc/list_admins', { method: 'POST', body: {} }, true).then(function (rows) {
        list.textContent = '';
        (rows || []).forEach(function (r) {
          var li = make('li', 'support-item');
          var head = make('div', 'support-item-head');
          head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-who', '@' + r.name));
          head.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', r.owner ? 'Owner' : 'Admin'));
          if (!r.owner) {
            var rm = make('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Remove admin'); rm.type = 'button';
            rm.style.marginLeft = 'auto';
            rm.addEventListener('click', function () {
              Dialog.confirm('Remove admin rights from @' + r.name + '?', 'Remove admin').then(function (yes) {
                if (!yes) return;
                Account.api('/rest/v1/rpc/demote_admin', { method: 'POST', body: { target: r.name } }, true)
                  .then(loadAdmins).catch(function (e) { Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Could not remove that admin.'); });
              });
            });
            head.appendChild(rm);
          }
          li.appendChild(head);
          list.appendChild(li);
        });
      }).catch(function (e) { list.textContent = ''; list.appendChild(make('li', 'support-empty', e.message || 'Could not load admins.')); });
    }
    function bindAdmins() {
      var form = document.getElementById('admins-form');
      if (!form) return;
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        var input = document.getElementById('admins-name'), msg = document.getElementById('admins-msg');
        var name = input.value.trim();
        if (!name) return;
        msg.textContent = '';
        Account.api('/rest/v1/rpc/promote_admin', { method: 'POST', body: { target: name } }, true)
          .then(function () { input.value = ''; msg.textContent = '@' + name + ' is now an admin.'; loadAdmins(); })
          .catch(function (e) { msg.textContent = e.message || 'Could not promote that account.'; });
      });
    }
    function act(req) { req.then(loadInbox).catch(function (e) { Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Could not save that change.'); }); }

    function renderInbox(rows, emails, threads) {
      emails = emails || {};
      threads = threads || {};
      rows = rows || [];
      var open = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'open'; }).length;
      el.count.textContent = open + ' open';
      if (el.navCount) el.navCount.textContent = open || '';
      el.list.textContent = '';
      if (!rows.length) { el.list.appendChild(make('li', 'support-empty', 'No messages yet.')); return; }
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var li = make('li', 'support-item' + (r.status === 'done' ? ' done' : ''));
        var head = make('div', 'support-item-head');
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', KINDS[r.kind] || r.kind));
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-who', r.username ? '@' + r.username : 'anonymous'));
        var em = r.username && emails[r.username.toLowerCase()];
        if (em) head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-email', em));
        head.appendChild(make('span', 'support-when', new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleString([], { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' })));
        li.appendChild(head);
        li.appendChild(make('p', 'support-msg', r.message));
        if ((threads[r.id] || []).length) li.appendChild(threadEl(threads[r.id], 0, ''));
        var rf = make('form', 'support-replyform');
        var rt = make('textarea', 'acct-input'); rt.rows = 2; rt.maxLength = 1000; rt.placeholder = 'Write a reply...'; rt.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Reply to @' + (r.username || 'user'));
        var rb = make('button', 'admin-add', 'Send reply'); rb.type = 'submit';
        rf.appendChild(rt); rf.appendChild(rb);
        rf.addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          var body = rt.value.trim();
          if (!body) return;
          rb.disabled = true;
          Account.api('/rest/v1/support_replies', { method: 'POST', body: { request_id: r.id, author: Account.username(), body: body }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }, true)
            .then(loadInbox)
            .catch(function (e) { rb.disabled = false; Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Could not send that reply.'); });
        });
        li.appendChild(rf);
        var tools = make('div', 'support-tools');
        var toggle = make('button', 'admin-ghost', r.status === 'done' ? 'Reopen' : 'Mark done'); toggle.type = 'button';
        toggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
          act(Account.api('/rest/v1/support_requests?id=eq.' + r.id, { method: 'PATCH', body: { status: r.status === 'done' ? 'open' : 'done' }, headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' } }, true));
        });
        var del = make('button', 'admin-ghost', 'Delete'); del.type = 'button';
        del.addEventListener('click', function () {
          Dialog.confirm('Delete this message?', 'Delete').then(function (yes) { if (yes) act(Account.api('/rest/v1/support_requests?id=eq.' + r.id, { method: 'DELETE' }, true)); });
        });
        tools.appendChild(toggle); tools.appendChild(del);
        li.appendChild(tools);
        el.list.appendChild(li);
      });
    }

    function submit(ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      var msg = el.message.value.trim();
      if (!Account.loggedIn()) { gate(); return; }
      if (msg.length < 5) return note('Please write a little more so we can help.');
      var last = 0; try { last = +localStorage.getItem(LAST_KEY) || 0; } catch (e) {}
      if (Date.now() - last < COOLDOWN) return note('Hang on a few seconds before sending another message.');
      if (el.hp.value) { note('Thanks! Your message was sent.'); el.message.value = ''; return; }
      el.send.disabled = true; note('');
      Account.api('/rest/v1/support_requests', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { Prefer: 'return=minimal' },
        body: { kind: el.kind.value, message: msg, username: Account.username() }
      }, true).then(function () {
        try { localStorage.setItem(LAST_KEY, String(Date.now())); } catch (e) {}
        el.message.value = '';
        note('Thanks! Your message was sent.');
        loadInbox();
      }).catch(function (e) {
        note(e.message || 'Could not send that. Please try again.');
      }).then(function () { el.send.disabled = false; });
    }

    return {
      init: function () {
        var $ = function (i) { return document.getElementById(i); };
        el = { form: $('support-form'), kind: $('support-kind'), message: $('support-message'), user: $('support-user'), hp: $('support-website'),
          send: $('support-send'), note: $('support-note'), list: $('support-list'), count: $('support-count'), wrap: $('support-form-wrap'),
          navBtn: document.getElementById('admin-group'), navCount: $('nav-count-inbox'), gate: $('support-gate'), login: $('support-login'),
          mineCard: $('support-mine'), mineList: $('support-mine-list'), supportBadge: $('nav-count-support') };
        if (!el.form) return;
        if (!Account.remote) { el.wrap.hidden = true; return; }
        el.form.addEventListener('submit', submit);
        el.login.addEventListener('click', Account.open);
        bindAdmins();
        bindUsers();
        gate();
        Account.onChange(function () { gate(); loadInbox(); refreshMine(); });
      },
      show: function () { gate(); refreshMine(); },
      showInbox: function () { loadInbox(); }
    };
  })();

  /* ---- Team page --------------------------------------------- *
   * Lists the owner and admins (see team_members() in supabase-team.sql).
   * Only names and roles are public.
   */
  var Team = (function () {
    var KEY = 'whiskered-team-cache', grid = null, note = null, members = null;
    function make(tag, cls, text) { var n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; }
    function render() {
      grid = grid || document.getElementById('team-grid');
      note = note || document.getElementById('team-note');
      if (!grid) return;
      grid.textContent = '';
      note.hidden = true;
      if (!members) { note.textContent = Account.remote ? 'Loading the team...' : 'Team info needs the online setup.'; note.hidden = false; return; }
      if (!members.length) { note.textContent = 'No team members to show yet.'; note.hidden = false; return; }
      members.forEach(function (m, i) {
        var li = make('li', 'team-card' + (m.owner ? ' owner' : ''));
        li.style.animationDelay = Math.min(i * 40, 320) + 'ms';
        var av = make('span', 'team-avatar', (m.display || m.name || '?').charAt(0)); av.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        var text = make('div', 'team-text');
        text.appendChild(make('strong', 'team-name', m.display || m.name));
        text.appendChild(make('span', 'team-handle', '@' + m.name));
        li.appendChild(av); li.appendChild(text);
        li.appendChild(make('span', 'link-badge', m.owner ? 'Owner' : 'Admin'));
        grid.appendChild(li);
      });
    }
    return {
      show: function () {
        if (!members) { try { members = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); } catch (e) { members = null; } }
        render();
        if (!Account.remote) return;
        Account.api('/rest/v1/rpc/team_members', { method: 'POST', body: {} }).then(function (rows) {
          members = rows || [];
          try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(members)); } catch (e) {}
          render();
        }).catch(function () {
          if (!members) { grid.textContent = ''; note.textContent = 'Could not load the team right now.'; note.hidden = false; }
        });
      }
    };
  })();

  /* ---- Forms inside sandboxed frames ------------------------- *
   * If this page is shown inside a frame that has no "allow-forms"
   * permission, the browser silently drops every form submit and none of
   * the buttons do anything. So buttons and the Enter key trigger the
   * forms' submit handlers directly instead of relying on the browser.
   */
  function installFormShim() {
    function fire(form) { form.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); }
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('button, input[type="submit"]') : null;
      if (!b || b.disabled || !b.form) return;
      var type = (b.getAttribute('type') || (b.tagName === 'BUTTON' ? 'submit' : '')).toLowerCase();
      if (type !== 'submit') return;
      e.preventDefault();
      fire(b.form);
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key !== 'Enter' || e.isComposing || e.shiftKey) return;
      var t = e.target;
      if (!t || t.tagName !== 'INPUT' || !t.form || /^(button|submit|checkbox|radio|file|reset)$/i.test(t.type)) return;
      if (!t.form.querySelector('button[type="submit"], button:not([type]), input[type="submit"]')) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      fire(t.form);
    }, true);
  }

  /* ---- Boot ------------------------------------------------ */
  function init() {
    document.body.classList.remove('no-js');
    installFormShim();
    var homeLink = document.querySelector('.topbar-link[data-nav="home"]');
    if (homeLink) homeLink.classList.add('active');
    loadPrefs();
    Account.init();
    applyPrefs();
    Links.applyCachedSites();
    Links.applyCachedOrder();
    enhancePanels();
    Links.applyCachedOverrides();
    buildItchioView();
    var qj = document.getElementById('quick-jump-list');
    if (qj) {
      SITES.slice().sort(function () { return Math.random() - 0.5; }).slice(0, 5).forEach(function (site) {
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'widget-item';
        b.innerHTML = '<span class="widget-item-icon" aria-hidden="true">' + escHtml(site.icon) + '</span><span>' + escHtml(site.label) + '</span>';
        b.addEventListener('click', function () { showPanel(site.id); });
        li.appendChild(b);
        qj.appendChild(li);
      });
    }
    Changelog.init();
    Support.init();
    var openCl = document.getElementById('open-changelog');
    if (openCl) openCl.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var m = document.getElementById('changelog-modal');
      if (m) { m.style.display = 'flex'; m.style.opacity = '1'; m.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; }
    });
    var cg = document.getElementById('count-games');
    if (cg) cg.textContent = GENRES.length + ' genres';
    var ncg = document.getElementById('nav-count-games');
    if (ncg) ncg.textContent = GENRES.length;
    updateSiteCounts();
    var sideTheme = document.getElementById('side-theme');
    if (sideTheme) sideTheme.addEventListener('click', function () {
      prefs.theme = prefs.theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
      applyPrefs(); savePrefs();
    });
    var sideCl = document.getElementById('side-changelog');
    if (sideCl) sideCl.addEventListener('click', function () { if (openCl) openCl.click(); });
    var sideCat = document.querySelector('.side-cat');
    if (sideCat) sideCat.addEventListener('click', function () { sideCat.classList.remove('purr'); void sideCat.offsetWidth; sideCat.classList.add('purr'); });
    buildWebsitesView();
    bindEvents();
    Links.load();
  }

  /* ---- Inject links button + back link into every panel ---- */
  /* ---- Rebuild each panel's links as a link board ----------- */
  function copyText(text, btn, label) {
    var done = function () {
      btn.classList.add('done');
      btn.textContent = 'Copied';
      setTimeout(function () { btn.classList.remove('done'); btn.textContent = label; }, 1300);
    };
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done, function () {});
    } else {
      var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
      try { document.execCommand('copy'); done(); } catch (e) {}
      ta.remove();
    }
  }

  function buildLinksBoard(section, siteId) {
    var anchors = Array.prototype.slice.call(section.querySelectorAll('a.site-link'));
    var creds = section.querySelector('.link-credentials');
    var isAdmin = !!siteId && Links.admin();
    if (!anchors.length && !creds && !isAdmin) return;
    section.textContent = '';

    if (creds) {
      creds.querySelectorAll('.cred-item').forEach(function (item) {
        var val = item.querySelector('.cred-value');
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'cred-copy'; b.textContent = 'Copy';
        b.addEventListener('click', function () { copyText(val.textContent, b, 'Copy'); });
        item.appendChild(b);
      });
      section.appendChild(creds);
    }
    if (!anchors.length) { if (isAdmin) section.appendChild(Links.form('site', siteId)); return; }

    var bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'links-bar';
    var count = document.createElement('span');
    count.className = 'links-count';
    count.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    bar.appendChild(count);
    var filter = null;
    if (anchors.length > 8) {
      filter = document.createElement('input');
      filter.type = 'search'; filter.className = 'links-filter';
      filter.placeholder = 'Filter links...'; filter.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Filter links');
      bar.appendChild(filter);
    }
    section.appendChild(bar);
    if (isAdmin) section.appendChild(Links.form('site', siteId));

    var list = document.createElement('ol');
    list.className = 'link-list';
    var cards = [];
    anchors.forEach(function (a, i) {
      var href = a.href, host = href, rest = '';
      try {
        var u = new URL(href);
        host = u.hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
        rest = (u.pathname === '/' ? '' : u.pathname) + u.search + u.hash;
      } catch (e) {}
      var row = a.closest('.link-row');
      var badge = row && row.querySelector('.link-badge');

      var li = document.createElement('li');
      li.className = 'link-card';
      li.style.animationDelay = Math.min(i * 25, 300) + 'ms';
      li.dataset.url = href;

      a.textContent = '';
      a.title = href;
      var num = document.createElement('span'); num.className = 'lc-num'; num.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      num.textContent = (i < 9 ? '0' : '') + (i + 1);
      var main = document.createElement('span'); main.className = 'lc-main';
      var h = document.createElement('span'); h.className = 'lc-host'; h.textContent = host;
      var pth = document.createElement('span'); pth.className = 'lc-path'; pth.textContent = rest;
      main.appendChild(h); main.appendChild(pth);
      if (badge) main.appendChild(badge);
      var go = document.createElement('span'); go.className = 'lc-go'; go.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); go.textContent = '\u2197';
      a.appendChild(num); a.appendChild(main); a.appendChild(go);

      var cp = document.createElement('button');
      cp.type = 'button'; cp.className = 'lc-copy'; cp.textContent = 'Copy';
      cp.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy link ' + (i + 1));
      cp.addEventListener('click', function () { copyText(href, cp, 'Copy'); });

      li.appendChild(a); li.appendChild(cp);
      if (isAdmin) { li.appendChild(Links.moveBtns(li, 'li.link-card', 'site:' + siteId, 'y')); li.appendChild(Links.removeBtn('site', siteId, href, a.dataset.editId)); }
      list.appendChild(li);
      cards.push(li);
    });
    section.appendChild(list);
    if (isAdmin) Links.sortable(list, 'li.link-card', 'site:' + siteId, 'y');

    var nomatch = document.createElement('p');
    nomatch.className = 'link-nomatch'; nomatch.textContent = 'No links match. Try another sniff?'; nomatch.hidden = true;
    section.appendChild(nomatch);

    function visibleCards() { return cards.filter(function (c) { return !c.hidden; }); }
    function updateCount() {
      var n = visibleCards().length;
      count.innerHTML = '<b>' + (n === cards.length ? n : n + '/' + cards.length) + '</b>' + (cards.length === 1 ? 'link' : 'links');
      nomatch.hidden = n !== 0;
    }
    if (filter) filter.addEventListener('input', function () {
      var q = filter.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      cards.forEach(function (c) { c.hidden = !!q && c.dataset.url.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1; });
      updateCount();
    });
    updateCount();
  }

  function enhancePanels(list) {
    var panels = list || document.querySelectorAll('.content-panel');
    panels.forEach(function (panel) {
      var inner = panel.querySelector('.panel-inner');
      var header = panel.querySelector('.panel-header');

      /* Back button – inserted before the header */
      if (inner && header) {
        var back = document.createElement('button');
        back.className = 'back-home-btn';
        back.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go back to home page');
        back.innerHTML = '<span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">←</span> Go back to home page';
        back.addEventListener('click', function () { setMode('websites'); });
        inner.insertBefore(back, header);
      }
      var linksSection = panel.querySelector('.links-section');
      var siteId = panel.id.replace('panel-', '');
      var siteIdx = SITES.findIndex(function (x) { return x.id === siteId; });
      var site = SITES[siteIdx];
      var linkCount = linksSection ? linksSection.querySelectorAll('a.site-link').length : 0;
      var firstLink = linksSection && linksSection.querySelector('a.site-link');
      var firstHref = firstLink ? firstLink.href : '';

      /* Banner */
      if (header && site) {
        var name = header.querySelector('h2');
        var icon = document.createElement('span');
        icon.className = 'ph-icon'; icon.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); icon.textContent = site.icon;
        var text = document.createElement('div');
        text.className = 'ph-text';
        var kicker = document.createElement('p');
        kicker.className = 'ph-kicker';
        kicker.textContent = 'Site ' + (siteIdx < 9 ? '0' : '') + (siteIdx + 1) + ' / ' + SITES.length + ' \u00b7 ' +
          (linkCount ? linkCount + (linkCount === 1 ? ' link' : ' links') : 'No links yet');
        var tag = document.createElement('p');
        tag.className = 'ph-tagline'; tag.textContent = site.tagline;
        text.appendChild(kicker); text.appendChild(name); text.appendChild(tag);
        header.textContent = '';
        header.appendChild(icon); header.appendChild(text);
        if (firstHref) {
          var actions = document.createElement('div');
          actions.className = 'ph-actions';
          var open = document.createElement('button');
          open.type = 'button'; open.className = 'ph-open'; open.textContent = 'Open first link \u2197';
          open.addEventListener('click', function () { window.open(firstHref, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer'); });
          actions.appendChild(open); header.appendChild(actions);
        }
      }
      var placeholder = panel.querySelector('.panel-image-placeholder');
      if (placeholder) placeholder.remove();
      if (back) back.innerHTML = '<span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">←</span> All websites';
      if (back) back.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Back to all websites');

      /* About card with prev / next */
      var desc = panel.querySelector('.panel-description');
      if (inner && desc && site) {
        var about = document.createElement('section');
        about.className = 'about-card';
        var h3 = document.createElement('h3'); h3.textContent = 'About';
        desc.parentNode.insertBefore(about, desc);
        about.appendChild(h3); about.appendChild(desc);

        var facts = document.createElement('div');
        facts.className = 'about-facts';
        [['Links', linkCount || '\u2014'], ['Entry', (siteIdx + 1) + ' of ' + SITES.length]].forEach(function (f) {
          var d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'about-fact';
          d.innerHTML = '<span></span><strong></strong>';
          d.firstChild.textContent = f[0]; d.lastChild.textContent = f[1];
          facts.appendChild(d);
        });
        about.appendChild(facts);

        var pager = document.createElement('div');
        pager.className = 'pager';
        fillPager(pager, siteIdx);
        about.appendChild(pager);
      }

      if (linksSection) { Links.remember(siteId, linksSection); buildLinksBoard(linksSection, siteId); }
    });
  }

  /* ---- Go back to welcome screen --------------------------- */
  function goHome() {
    var allTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-item');
    allTabs.forEach(function (t, i) {
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      t.classList.remove('active');
      t.setAttribute('tabindex', i === 0 ? '0' : '-1');
    });

    if (prevPanel) {
      var leaving = prevPanel;
      leaving.classList.remove('active');
      leaving.classList.add('exiting');
      setTimeout(function () {
        leaving.classList.remove('exiting');
        leaving.hidden = true;
      }, 200);
      prevPanel = null;
    }

    var welcome = document.getElementById('welcome-screen');
    if (welcome) welcome.classList.remove('hidden');

    activeTabId = null;
    history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.search);

    /* Return focus to first tab */
    if (allTabs.length) allTabs[0].focus();
  }

  /* ---- Event wiring ---------------------------------------- */
  function bindEvents() {
    var btnItchio = document.getElementById('btn-itchio');
    var btnWebsites = document.getElementById('btn-websites');
    var itchioBack = document.getElementById('itchio-back-btn');
    var openCustomizeBtn = document.getElementById('open-customize');
    var closeCustomizeBtn = document.getElementById('close-customize');
    var customizeOverlay = document.getElementById('customize-overlay');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); setMode(el.getAttribute('data-nav')); });
    });
    if (btnItchio) btnItchio.addEventListener('click', function () { setMode('itchio'); });
    if (btnWebsites) btnWebsites.addEventListener('click', function () { setMode('websites'); });
    if (itchioBack) itchioBack.addEventListener('click', function () { setMode('home'); });
    if (openCustomizeBtn) openCustomizeBtn.addEventListener('click', openCustomizePanel);
    if (closeCustomizeBtn) closeCustomizeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeCustomizePanel);
    if (customizeOverlay) customizeOverlay.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target === customizeOverlay) closeCustomizePanel();
    });


    var itchioGenreBack = document.getElementById('itchio-genre-back-btn');
    if (itchioGenreBack) itchioGenreBack.addEventListener('click', function () { setMode('itchio'); });

    var websitesHomeBtn = document.getElementById('websites-back-btn');
    if (websitesHomeBtn) websitesHomeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { setMode('home'); });

    var tabList = document.getElementById('tab-list');
    if (tabList) {
      tabList.addEventListener('click', onTabClick);
      tabList.addEventListener('keydown', onTabKeydown);
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (customizeOpen) closeCustomizePanel();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var chip = e.target.closest('[data-theme-choice], [data-accent-choice], [data-density-choice], [data-toggle], [data-reset]');
      if (!chip) return;
      if (chip.hasAttribute('data-reset')) {
        prefs.theme = 'dark';
        prefs.accent = 'orange';
        prefs.density = 'comfortable';
        prefs.welcome = true;
        prefs.reducedMotion = false;
      } else if (chip.getAttribute('data-theme-choice')) {
        prefs.theme = chip.getAttribute('data-theme-choice');
      } else if (chip.getAttribute('data-accent-choice')) {
        prefs.accent = chip.getAttribute('data-accent-choice');
      } else if (chip.getAttribute('data-density-choice')) {
        prefs.density = chip.getAttribute('data-density-choice');
      } else if (chip.getAttribute('data-toggle') === 'welcome') {
        prefs.welcome = !prefs.welcome;
      } else if (chip.getAttribute('data-toggle') === 'motion') {
        prefs.reducedMotion = !prefs.reducedMotion;
      }
      savePrefs();
      applyPrefs();
    });

    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onHashChange);
  }

  /* ---- Tab click ------------------------------------------- */
  function onTabClick(e) {
    var item = e.target.closest('.tab-item');
    if (!item) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    activateTab(item.id.replace('tab-', ''));
  }

  /* ---- Tab keyboard ---------------------------------------- */
  function onTabKeydown(e) {
    var tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tab-item'));
    var idx = tabs.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    var next;

    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight':
        e.preventDefault();
        next = (idx + 1) % tabs.length;
        moveFocus(tabs, next);
        break;
      case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft':
        e.preventDefault();
        next = (idx - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
        moveFocus(tabs, next);
        break;
      case 'Home':
        e.preventDefault();
        moveFocus(tabs, 0);
        break;
      case 'End':
        e.preventDefault();
        moveFocus(tabs, tabs.length - 1);
        break;
      case 'Enter': case ' ':
        e.preventDefault();
        var focused = document.activeElement;
        if (focused && focused.classList.contains('tab-item')) {
          activateTab(focused.id.replace('tab-', ''));
        }
        break;
    }
  }

  function moveFocus(tabs, idx) {
    tabs.forEach(function (t, i) {
      t.setAttribute('tabindex', i === idx ? '0' : '-1');
    });
    tabs[idx].focus();
    tabs[idx].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  /* ---- Activate tab ---------------------------------------- */
  function activateTab(siteId) {
    if (activeTabId === siteId) return;

    var tab = document.getElementById('tab-' + siteId);
    var panel = document.getElementById('panel-' + siteId);
    if (!tab || !panel) return;

    /* Deactivate previous tab */
    var allTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-item');
    allTabs.forEach(function (t) {
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      t.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
      t.classList.remove('active');
    });

    /* Exit previous panel */
    if (prevPanel && prevPanel !== panel) {
      var leaving = prevPanel;
      leaving.classList.remove('active');
      leaving.classList.add('exiting');
      var onEnd = function () {
        leaving.classList.remove('exiting');
        leaving.hidden = true;
        leaving.removeEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
      };
      leaving.addEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
    }

    /* Activate new tab */
    activeTabId = siteId;
    tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    tab.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
    tab.classList.add('active');
    tab.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });

    /* Show new panel */
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.remove('exiting');
    /* Trigger paint before adding .active so transition fires */
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        panel.classList.add('active');
        panel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      });
    });
    prevPanel = panel;

    /* Hide welcome screen */
    var welcome = document.getElementById('welcome-screen');
    if (welcome) welcome.classList.add('hidden');

    /* Update URL hash silently */
    history.replaceState(null, '', '#panel-' + siteId);
  }

  /* ---- Hash routing ---------------------------------------- */
  function handleHashOnLoad() {
    var hash = window.location.hash.replace('#panel-', '').replace('#', '');
    if (!hash) return;
    var match = SITES.find(function (s) { return s.id === hash; });
    if (match) activateTab(match.id);
  }

  function onHashChange() {
    var hash = window.location.hash.replace('#panel-', '').replace('#', '');
    if (hash && hash !== activeTabId) {
      var match = SITES.find(function (s) { return s.id === hash; });
      if (match) activateTab(match.id);
    }
  }

  /* ---- Start ----------------------------------------------- */
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }

}());

window.addEventListener("load", () => {
  const modal = document.getElementById("changelog-modal");
  modal.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
  modal.style.opacity = "1";
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById("close-changelog");
  const modal = document.getElementById("changelog-modal");

  const close = () => { modal.style.display = "none"; };
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", close);
  modal.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === modal) close(); });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") close(); });
});
</script>

</body>
</html>
